items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue and GTD/optimism. Schefter confirmed active; Berry and Rapoport corroborated.
items.why: Calf; feeling better Saturday, no setbacks, McVay optimistic.
items.implication: Start with confidence; high target share expected with Adams out.
items.opportunity: Primary WR routes/targets/red-zone in depleted Rams WR room.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall officially INACTIVE (quad). Rapoport: unlikely then confirmed inactive; Schefter listed among inactives. ETR had GTD/pessimism.
items.why: Quad strain; limited practice, not full participant after missing three games.
items.implication: Another week ramp-up; primary backfield to committee lead.
items.opportunity: Full early-down/third-down snaps to backup RB (Braelon Allen context).

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially OUT for Week 7. ETR morning summary listed him OUT; Rapoport noted he was close and should return next week.
items.implication: Ravens backup QB; elevated volume for Henry and pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and receiving work to Derrick Henry, Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews/Isaiah Likely.

items.text: ETR gold-standard Sun morning: GTD Mike Washington; GTD/opt Puka; GTD/pess Breece; IN Jacobs/Coleman/Kirk/Mason/Dell/Sampson; Expected Saquon; OUT Lamar/Smith/Wicks. Direct + implied opps.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports into clear buckets for fantasy decisions.
items.implication: Baseline for all status changes and beneficiary identification.
items.opportunity: Implied snaps to backups/handcuffs on OUT/INACTIVE.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs turned ankle on purposeful slide; Levitan: almost certainly fine. Would have been tilting if injured while correctly not scoring. ETR watching list.
items.why: Ankle turned on slide; Levitan player-specific: almost certainly fine.
items.implication: Low concern for next week; no major fantasy downgrade yet.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected lead back, delivered 124 yards on 17 carries + TD. Postgame felt hamstring on OT slide (not purposeful); bye helps. Levitan thinks actually hurt but not certain. Tracy also hamstring.
items.why: Rap: expected resume lead role; production confirmed; postgame hamstring feel + bye.
items.implication: Strong RB2 rebound confirmed; monitor hamstring into bye for ROS role.
items.opportunity: Early-down/goal-line carries locked when healthy; Tracy absence boosts.
items.conflict: Berry pregame hated Skattebo tough matchup/role.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey to locker room (quad/thigh) then returned. Schefter and Rapoport confirmed Q to return then back in game. ETR watching.
items.implication: Finished game; monitor for lingering next week amid 49ers WR outs.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT. ETR Sunday summary; impacts Eagles pass game volume distribution.
items.why: ETR listed under OUT in weekend reports summary.
items.implication: Elevated targets/routes for remaining Eagles pass-catchers; A.J. Brown usage bump if available.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route share and red-zone looks for other PHI WRs/TEs.
items.conflict: Berry had loved DeVonta pre-OUT for volume.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play. ETR listed under IN; Schefter confirmed among activated players expected to play.
items.why: Activated; Schefter group of expected-to-play activations.
items.implication: Immediate lead back role return post-layoff; monitor snap share.
items.opportunity: Carries, goal-line, early-down work in Packers backfield.
items.conflict: Berry hated Jacobs post-layoff workload questions.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (MNF context). ETR listed expected; Berry noted in line to play vs Dallas with efficient prior usage and good matchup.
items.why: Returned to practice; efficient in full games played.
items.implication: Start if confirmed; strong RB matchup vs Dallas.
items.opportunity: High carry/target share and red-zone if active.

items.text: Panthers RT Taylor Moton fractured fibula, out indefinitely (second game back from blood clot). Schefter and Rapoport (coach Canales).
items.why: Fractured fibula in loss to Bucs.
items.implication: OL downgrade impacts Panthers run/pass protection and fantasy RBs/QB.

items.text: ETR late Sunday injuries watching: Jaylen Waddle (shoulder), Kenny Gainwell (hip, returned), Aaron Jones (knee), plus others. Monitor for next week.
items.why: In-game issues flagged in ETR summary.
items.implication: Check Monday reports; Gainwell returned so lower immediate concern.

items.text: Broncos CB Pat Surtain II inactive (ankle). Schefter and Rapoport (unlikely then official).
items.why: Ankle; missed prior games, good chance next week.
items.implication: Weaker Broncos secondary; boosts opposing WR matchups.

items.text: Levitan: All ETR projections fully updated to latest statuses (Lamar/Puka/Breece crucial). Player-specific process on big projections people avoid is good.
items.why: Reflects morning injury summary and later actives/inactives.
items.implication: Trust ETR numbers post-status lock for DFS/start-sit.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10) for usage and matchup; Bears good for yardage. Confirmed Puka active separately.
items.why: Back in real role; Bears defense allows yardage; usage/matchup.

items.text: Berry LOVES Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6); Lions TE buffet (allowed 9 TE TDs). Volume RBs also loved: Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving.
items.why: Lions TE vulnerability; volume RBs in friendly matchups/workloads.
items.implication: TE streamer/start; RB2/flex locks on volume.
items.opportunity: Red-zone/TE targets for Kraft; carries for Warren/Hubbard/Irving.

items.text: Berry HATES Rome Odunze vs NE (shadow by Gonzalez, outside targets) and Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low-scoring offense). Also hated Kelce tough D and Jacobs post-layoff.
items.why: Nasty matchups/shadows; role/target issues; Jacobs layoff workload risk.
